sampleSource: 32x24 synthetic RGBA arrays with warm/cool border colors and identical face-colored center

estimator.privacy: local arrays only; estimator retains aggregate filtered RGB/luminance/confidence, never the image

result: Candidate warm/cool samples changed actual desktop WebGL output on all three synthetic poses. The estimator is now integrated into the local camera loop with an opt-out.
limitations: Synthetic colors do not model camera auto-exposure, environment illumination, or real material appearance.
No live camera, human subject, mobile device, front/side/back lighting sweep, flicker test, or performance/battery measurement was performed.
Real-camera lighting quality, exposure behavior and mobile cost still need user/device testing.
